data.name: Ashya
data.gender_notes: Ashya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who is the embodiment of life and existence. It is derived from the root word 'Ashaa' which means 'to live'. The name Ashya carries the meaning “Life, Existence” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ashya usually hope their child will grow to embody life, existence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Ashya signifies the divine presence of Allah in every living being. It is a reminder of the importance of cherishing and nurturing all forms of life.
data.etymology: Ashya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Life, Existence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ashya total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: أشيا
in_arabic.meaning: أشيا تعني الحياة أو النجاة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أشيا مشتق من الجذر العربي 'أش ي' والذي يرتبط بمعاني الحياة والبقاء والنجاة. وردت مشتقات هذا الجذر في القرآن الكريم في سياقات مختلفة تتعلق بالحياة والموت والبعث. اسم أشيا يرمز إلى الأمل والبقاء والحياة الطيبة.

in_urdu.name: اشیا
in_urdu.meaning: اشیا کا مطلب زندگی یا بقا کے طور پر ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: اشیا نام عربی جڑ 'أش ي' سے نکلا ہے، جو زندگی، بقا، اور گزرنے کے معنی سے وابستہ ہے۔ اس جڑ کے مشتقات قرآن مجید میں مختلف سیاق و سباق میں حیات، موت، اور آخرت کے حوالے سے ذکر کیے گئے ہیں۔ اشیا نام امید، بقا، اور اچھی زندگی کی علامت ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں۔

in_hindi.name: अश्या
in_hindi.meaning: अश्या का अर्थ जीवन या अस्तित्व है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अश्या नाम अरबी मूल 'أش ي' से लिया गया है, जो जीवन, अस्तित्व और गुजरने के अर्थों से जुड़ा हुआ है। इस मूल के व्युत्पन्न قرآن में विभिन्न संदर्भों में जीवन, मृत्यु और पुनरुत्थान के बारे में बताए गए हैं। अश्या नाम आशा, अस्तित्व और अच्छे जीवन का प्रतीक है, खासकर भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में।

in_pashto.name: اشیا
in_pashto.meaning: اشیا د ژوند یا بقا مطلب دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: اشیا نوم د عربي ريښې 'أش ي' څخه اخستل شوی دی، کوم چې د ژوند، بقا، او تېرېدنې معنی سره تړاو لري. د دې ريښې مشتقات په قرآن کريم کې د مختلفو موضوعاتو په اړه چې ژوند، مرګ، او قيامت پورې اړه لري، ذکر شوي دي. اشيا نوم د اميد، بقا، او ښه ژوند نښه ده، په ځانګړي ډول د افغان او پښتني دوديزو کې.

in_english.name: Ashya
in_english.meaning: Ashya means life, survival, or living a good life
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ashya is derived from the Arabic root 'أش ي' (Ash-y), which relates to concepts of life, existence, and survival. This root and its derivatives are mentioned in the Quran in various contexts concerning life, death, and the afterlife. Ashya symbolizes hope, resilience, and a good life. It carries spiritual significance and historical usage across Islamic traditions, reflecting the values of vitality and positive existence.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ashya holds a deep cultural significance in the Islamic world. It is a beautiful and poetic name that resonates with the belief in the concept of life and existence being the ultimate goal. It emphasizes the value and worth of life and the importance of living a meaningful and purposeful life. It can also be seen as a reminder of the transient nature of material possessions and worldly pursuits, and the emphasis on the inner soul and spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ashya signifies the embodiment of the divine energy of life and existence. It is a reminder of the inherent worth and dignity of every being, and the importance of nurturing the soul and inner self to live a life in harmony with the divine will. It invites us to grow spiritually, to develop inner strength and resilience, and to strive towards self-improvement and personal growth. Ultimately, Ashya is a name that inspires us to live our best possible lives and to make the most of our time on this earth.
